feeds.title: Lauren Fraser Equine Behaviourist Blog
feeds.description: Lauren Fraser is an experienced horsewoman, who has worked with horses professionally since 2006. She is qualified to help you solve your horse's behavior or training problem, using techniques both you and your horse will feel good about. Find Science-based horse behavior and training articles your horse would want you to read.

feeds.title: The Canadian Horse Defence Coalition Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Horse Defence Coalition is a collective of people, and national groups, who have joined forces to ban the slaughter of horses for human consumption in Canada. As well, the CHDC is lobbying to ban the inhumane transport and export of live horses to other countries for the same purpose.

feeds.title: Saddle Seeks Horse
feeds.description: Saddle Seeks Horse is a lifestyle blog for the everyday equestrian! Hi, I'm Susan Friedland, since 2013, Saddle Seeks Horse has been a platform to share my equestrian journey, a place to connect with fellow grown-up horse girls, and a blog biz!

feeds.title: NOËLLE FLOYD Blog
feeds.description: A fresh take on show jumping, eventing, dressage, and more. What started as a blog has become so much more. We're on a mission to empower equestrians by helping them learn from the best trainers and teachers with Equestrian Masterclass.

feeds.title: Horse Listening Blog
feeds.description: Find articles on horse listening, horse riding, horse life, and horses overall on the Horse Listening Blog! This site is especially for people who spend time with horses because of their passion, attraction and love for the horse. Informational resources, free articles. Rider & horse development, 'how to', thought-provoking and even playing around posts, celebrating our equine friends in every way.

feeds.title: Milestone Equestrian Blog
feeds.description: A horse training business based in beautiful British Columbia, Canada. Specializing in starting horses under saddle, working with retiring racehorses, problem horses, and equine behavior consultations. The owner of this blog Shelby, firmly believes that good handling starts with providing horses with ample turnout and the ability to express their natural behaviors.

feeds.title: Horse Sport
feeds.description: Horse Sport has been the voice of equestrian competition in Canada. Our readers are dedicated owners, competitors, trainers, and breeders who are highly involved in the equine marketplace. We're an invaluable resource for news relating to the horse industry, training advice from professionals, profiles of top riders, equine health issues, and other topics important to owners, riders, trainers, breeders, and coaches.

feeds.title: JULIE CLAIRE Blog
feeds.description: JULIE CLAIRE Blog provides thought-provoking articles on all matters of equestrian - juggling horses and life, making time for riding, being an equestrian mom, mental health, and horses.

feeds.title: Equestrian Next Door Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to everyday equestrians who love riding and putting around in the area. If you love your horse and riding, this is for you. Equestrian Next Door is a Canadian online shop for trail riders. We sell high-quality trail gear from reputable suppliers across the country. Our goal is to provide quality gear at affordable prices so that everyone can enjoy the thrill of riding out on horseback.

feeds.title: Western Horse Review Blog
feeds.description: Western Horse Review is everything you'd love to know about western riding and culture in Canada! We write articles on great gear, fashion, travel, round pen, horse & health, western kitchen, and cowboy culture!

feeds.title: Ontario Equestrians
feeds.description: Find blog posts & latest news from Ontario Equestrian. we are focused on enhancing the experience for our members. Since its inception in 1977, we've been dedicated to promoting the sport and providing programs, while establishing support and guidelines for a safe and level field of play for both equine and human athletes.
